note: CANVAS-26: a restore appends a new version equal to an earlier one, so nothing is lost and it needs no base revision. It is idempotent by nature: restoring a version the document already equals changes nothing and creates no version. The answer is the whole Document.

invalid.name: no version
invalid.why: a restore names what it restores

invalid.name: the handoff's version label
invalid.why: a version is named by its number

invalid.name: content sent with the restore
invalid.why: the server restores what it stored; a client can never supply 'history'
